prompt: Single game boss sprite: a tall gaunt hunched boss, about 3 heads tall, top-heavy with huge long arms and big hands and a small head in a long-beaked plague mask, a ragged muted purple-grey hooded robe with a torn hem and short legs, holding a curved fang-shaped dagger in each hand, its blade a pale bone colour tipped with sickly green; its ONE signature feature is a huge swollen venom sac strapped to its back, drawn as a sickly green bulb with a flat layered drip; the outlines are dark purple. Three-quarter view facing down-right, as if walking toward the bottom-right of the screen. Neutral ready pose, standing, full body and weapons inside the frame with margin on every side, centered, filling about 70% of the frame. The face is only a brow line and a small eye slit, hands are simple mitten shapes. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject. Stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a top-down fantasy tower defense game, designed to read at about 120 pixels tall. Simple design: big clear shapes and a strong silhouette; small details are left out or merged into larger shapes; faces, hands, armour and clothing are suggested with a few lines, never rendered in fine detail. Stylized, exaggerated cartoon proportions, not realistic anatomy (about 2.5 to 4 heads tall): the parts that express the character's role are enlarged and the rest is shrunk, so the silhouette reads at 120 pixels. Colour: flat solid fills only, absolutely no gradients, no soft shading, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. Volume and shadow come from 2-3 hard-edged tones of the same colour (shadow, base, light), plus a few small highlight shapes. Thick clean outlines in a dark shade of the neighbouring colour. Effects (poison drips) are drawn as stacked layers of flat single-colour vector shapes with an outline that follows the effect's form, never as soft blur or gradient glow. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
